title: Work Tape Rewind
statement: Let $q$ and $d$ be control states of the verifier. Suppose that in state $q$, for every input symbol and work-tape reading, the machine moves the work head one cell left and remains in $q$ when the scanned work cell is nonblank; when it is blank, it moves the work head one cell right and enters $d$. For every binary input $x$, every $i\le |x|$, every binary word $u$, and every natural number $n\le |u|$, starting in state $q$ with input head having consumed $i$ bits, work tape containing $u$, and work head at $n-1$, after exactly $n+1$ steps the machine is in state $d$ with work head at $0$, while the input head, tape contents, and output remain unchanged.
hypotheses_covered: transition behavior is specified for every input symbol and work-tape reading
replaced:
Let $q$ and $d$ be control states of the non-tautology verifier such that, in state
$q$, it silently moves the work head left with the input head fixed whenever the work
cell is nonblank, and otherwise moves the work head right and enters $d$. Then for
every input $x$, index $i \le |x|$, work word $u$, and $n \le |u|$, starting in state
$q$ with work head at cell $n - 1$, exactly $n + 1$ steps reach state $d$ with work
head at cell $0$, all other components unchanged.
